ruling: user, 2026-09-14/15 (sixth of the day): stop treating the boundary as 'pure L1 vs full L3'; add uL3 (micro-L3), a tiny bounded dynamic graph expansion whose only job is to repair P50 (scientifically dynamic, architecturally an L1 booster before full L3). One arm first: MICRO_L3_H2. The hop2/hop3 result is the gate: 'We already know almost anything can improve MetaQA hop1. If hop2+hop3 move strongly, then we have finally found the missing mechanism. If they do not, stop.' Latent global beam = ablation inside the experiment, not the main mechanism.
population: DEV_A only (split A by sha1(qid)); DEV_B remains untouched (read twice already); no query subsetting; corpus never subset

design.seeds: B0 = the frozen SEED_K = 5 replay-cache seeds (frozen RRF top-5 entity hits of Dense+SPLADE); seeds are marked visited and do not vote in the repair channel (they already vote in the served channels)
design.graph: ACTUAL directed STRUCT adjacency of the canonical corpus (D.cd.struct_csr(directed=True)); no KNN, no NER, no generated edges
design.admissibility: frozen non-hub / degree-cap policy: cap = round(N / npart); hub(v) := deg_undirected(v) + 1 > cap; transitions from v = all directed out-neighbours, plus in-neighbours only when v is a non-hub; targets already visited are excluded
design.depth: exactly 2 hops (anchor -> intermediate m -> answer-like a)
design.beam: BEAM = K_LOCK = 100 distinct targets per hop (frozen router width); visited nodes per query <= 5 + 200
design.transition_scoring: frozen node embeddings only (fp16 memmap rows, unit-normalised), per candidate transition v->u: S_dst = cos(q, e_u); S_dir = cos(q - e_v, e_u - e_v) (closed form (a_u - a_v - c + 1)/(sqrt(2-2a_v) sqrt(2-2c)), degenerate 2-2c < 1e-6 -> -1); S_mid = cos(q, norm(e_v + e_u)) = (a_v + a_u)/sqrt(2+2c); the three rank lists fused by the frozen RRF 1/(K0 + rank), K0 = 60; beam = the first BEAM distinct unvisited u in fused order; every parameter is a frozen contract constant (K0, K_LOCK, P50, cap) -- nothing chosen for this experiment
design.repair_channel: visited nodes in order (hop-1 beam then hop-2 beam) vote through the served static membership table (own block + directed out-neighbour blocks, the frozen builder's mem(v)) exactly like L1 hits: w_r = 1/(K0 + r) into float32 S (sum) and M (max), votes = rr(S) + rr(M); blocks with no vote stay unranked (-1)
design.fusion: repaired P50 = _l1x90_core.fuse(C, base_rank, repair_order, 'RRF'): the frozen symmetric two-way RRF between the served fused block order and the repair order (unranked -> weight 0, stable argsort, top-50); chosen over a three-channel F0 so the repair can displace weak base blocks; output exactly P50
design.same_algorithm_everywhere: no training, no modified embeddings, no relation lists, no MetaQA templates, no dataset switch, no per-relation parameters, no thresholds; identical code path on KB and text caches
design.latent_ablation: --latent: identical scoring, beam width, depth, repair and fusion, but the candidate targets of a transition are EVERY non-visited node (latent global beam over the full unit node matrix) instead of the actual admissible neighbours; run on the two metaqa caches only (diagnostic: does the actual topology matter, or would latent offsets do the same?)

arms.L1: served canonical P50 (base_rank[:50]); asserted identical to the frozen BASE of the replay cache
arms.MICRO_L3_H2: PRIMARY: the real-edge beam, depth 2, repair with hop-1 + hop-2 visited nodes
arms.MICRO_L3_H1: breakdown only (same run truncated after hop 1: repair with the hop-1 beam) -- not a separate mechanism, not a selectable arm

metrics: ALL-gold@P50 (BASE_ALL) and ANY on DEV_A, overall and per hop (hop1/hop2/hop3 on metaqa)
reach (all gold blocks received a vote from some channel), UNREACHED pts, reached-failed pts
initial UNREACHED (under L1) -> now reached -> now ALL-gold@P50, after hop 1 and after hop 2, overall and per hop
exact two-sided McNemar vs L1: overall BASE_ALL, reach, per hop, and hop2+hop3 pooled
cost per query: transitions (edges) scored per hop and total (mean, p95), nodes visited, beam wall-clock ms (mean/p50/p95), repair+fusion ms, queries whose seeds are all hubs
blocks voted per query, scope nodes in P50

decision_rule.gate: hop2 + hop3 pooled ALL-gold@P50, MICRO_L3_H2 vs L1, on BOTH metaqa caches (metaqa MTKAHYPAR and metaqa_phg): McNemar gained > lost with p < 0.01 AND pooled gain >= +5.0 points on each cache
decision_rule.STRONG: gate passes AND pooled hop2+hop3 gain >= +10.0 points on each metaqa cache -> MICRO_L3 = CANDIDATE_STRONG (the missing mechanism is a small amount of dynamic state propagation); next step = DEV_B is NOT read; transfer test on a genuinely untouched population needs a ruling
decision_rule.CANDIDATE: gate passes with pooled gain in [+5.0, +10.0) on either cache -> MICRO_L3 = CANDIDATE (moves, not strongly); report and ask for a ruling before any variant
decision_rule.else: MICRO_L3_H2 = NOT_CONFIRMED on DEV_A -> STOP (per the ruling: 'If they do not, stop'); no beam/depth/scoring/fusion variants without a new pre-registration
decision_rule.text_constraint: squad, squad_phg, musique: a significant regression (lost > gained, p < 0.05) on any text cache is reported as a universality violation and blocks promotion regardless of the metaqa gate (same algorithm everywhere); an improvement on text is welcome but not required
decision_rule.hop1: hop-1 gains are expected and carry no weight in the gate
decision_rule.latent_ablation: no gate; reported as information (real-edge beam vs latent global beam on hop2+hop3)

secondary_expectations_pre_registered: hop 1 improves on both metaqa caches (as every prior channel did)
if the mechanism is right, initial UNREACHED queries in hop2/hop3 become reached after hop 2 in large numbers (the intermediate node m is instantiated on the actual graph)
the latent global beam is weaker than the real-edge beam on hop2+hop3 (topology carries the information offsets could not)
text caches: little movement either way (their golds are already reached; the repair channel adds neighbours of top hits which are mostly already voted)
forbidden_after_seeing_numbers: changing BEAM, DEPTH, SEED_K, the scoring, the fusion rule or the admissibility policy
